description:
Seo-Jin, who is obsessed with men but is constantly wooed by women, goes to see a famous shaman with her best friend Yeon-Hee. The shaman tells her that Seo-Jin does not have men's clothing but is popular with the same sex, while Yeon-Hee has a peach blossom arrow and is popular with the opposite sex, but is jealous and envied by the same sex. After confirming their opposing fates, the shaman gives them an amulet that will alleviate their luck. She also prophesies that this amulet will change their fates. Seo-Jin is half-believing the shaman's words and forgets about the amulet, throwing it in a corner of the house. However, Yeon-Hee thoroughly believes in the amulet and always carries it with her, trying to prove its effectiveness to Seo-Jin...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology (\[GL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울)*
